# sophosfirewall_ipv4_address (Resource)

Manages an IPv4 address object (*Objects > Hosts and services > IP host*). Set exactly one of `ip_address`, `network`, `range_start`/`range_end` or `ip_addresses`; switching between them recreates the object.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A single host
resource "sophosfirewall_ipv4_address" "web_server" {
  name        = "web-server"
  description = "Public web server"
  ip_address  = "203.0.113.10"
}

# A network in CIDR notation
resource "sophosfirewall_ipv4_address" "corp_lan" {
  name    = "corp-lan"
  network = "192.0.2.0/24"
}

# An address range
resource "sophosfirewall_ipv4_address" "dhcp_pool" {
  name        = "dhcp-pool"
  range_start = "192.0.2.100"
  range_end   = "192.0.2.200"
}

# A list of hosts
resource "sophosfirewall_ipv4_address" "dns_servers" {
  name         = "dns-servers"
  ip_addresses = ["192.0.2.53", "198.51.100.53"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the IPv4 address object.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `ip_address` (String) A single host address.
- `ip_addresses` (Set of String) A list of host addresses.
- `network` (String) A network in CIDR notation, e.g. `192.0.2.0/24`.
- `range_end` (String) Last address of an address range. Requires `range_start`.
- `range_start` (String) First address of an address range. Requires `range_end`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the object assigned by the firewall.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by name or UUID.
terraform import sophosfirewall_ipv4_address.example <name-or-uuid>
```
